question: Who assisted Kendrick Nunn most often in this game?
generated_sparql:
PREFIX bball: <http://www.ics.forth.gr/isl/Basketball#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?assistingPlayerName (COUNT(?action) AS ?assistCount) WHERE {
  ?game a bball:Game ; bball:hasSeason ?season ; bball:hasCode "333" ; bball:hasPlayByPlayAction ?action .
  ?season bball:hasCode "E2023".
  ?action rdf:type bball:Assist ; bball:actionPlayer ?assistingPlayer .
  ?assistingPlayer rdfs:label ?assistingPlayerName .
  ?shot rdf:type ?madeShotType ; bball:hasAssist ?action ; bball:actionPlayer ?receivingPlayer .
  VALUES ?madeShotType { bball:TwoPointShotMade bball:ThreePointShotMade bball:FreeThrowMade }
  ?receivingPlayer rdfs:label ?receivingPlayerName .
  FILTER(regex(str(?receivingPlayerName), '(^|[^A-Za-z0-9])Kendrick Nunn([^A-Za-z0-9]|$)', 'i'))
} GROUP BY ?assistingPlayerName ORDER BY DESC(?assistCount) LIMIT 1
